lines.text: Wives are told to submit to their husbands, and husbands to love their wives and not be harsh.
Children are told to obey their parents in everything, because this is pleasing to the Lord.
Slaves are told to obey their earthly masters sincerely, and will receive a crown from the Lord.
Devote yourselves to prayer, watchful and sorrowful, asking God to open a door for the word.
Act wisely toward outsiders, and let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt.
